name: perique-plugin-scaffold
description: Opinionated scaffold for PinkCrab Perique 2.1.* plugins. scripts/scaffold-init.php prompts for or reads the placeholders below and rewrites the tree.

placeholders.label: Plugin name
placeholders.description: Human-readable name shown in the WordPress admin plugins list.

placeholders.label: Plugin slug
placeholders.description: kebab-case slug used for the main file name, default text domain, REST namespace prefix, and CSS class prefix on the hello-world demo.

placeholders.label: Plugin description
placeholders.description: One-line description for the plugin header and composer.json.

placeholders.label: Plugin URI
placeholders.description: Homepage URL for the plugin (header + package.json).

placeholders.label: PSR-4 namespace
placeholders.description: Top-level PHP namespace using SINGLE backslashes (e.g. Acme\MyPlugin). The setup script also derives ##NAMESPACE_ESCAPED## with doubled backslashes for composer.json.

placeholders.label: Text domain
placeholders.description: Used for translation lookups. Defaults to the plugin slug.

placeholders.label: Function prefix
placeholders.description: snake_case with trailing underscore, prefixed to every global function (e.g. myplugin_get_plugin_instance).

placeholders.label: Constant prefix
placeholders.description: UPPER_CASE with trailing underscore, prefixed to every global constant (e.g. MYPLUGIN_VERSION).

placeholders.label: REST API namespace
placeholders.description: Namespace registered with WordPress REST (e.g. my-plugin/v1).
